'''Darth Chratis' meditation sarcophagus''' was an oblong [[Sith sarcophagus|coffin]] that served the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] as a [[Meditation chamber/Legends|meditation chamber]]. An hour a day [[Darth Chratis]] would meditate without breathing. Even from within he could be heard and appear menacing to [[Eldon Ax]].
